field.name: description
field.help: A short description of this field, visible to users.

field.name: only_qualified
field.help: If checked, only manually verified professionals can answer questions in this field.

field.name: auto_karma_qualify
field.help: Automatically grant Qualified Professional status when the Karma threshold is reached. Disable for regulated fields (medical, legal) where credentials must be checked.

div.p: Require Manual Verification – when enabled, only professionals who have been manually approved (or automatically qualified via Karma, if the option below is also enabled) will appear in the "Ask Someone" matching list.

Auto-Qualify by Karma – this setting is only available when manual verification is required. If checked, the system will automatically add a user to the Qualified Professionals list once they reach the reputation threshold. Do not enable this for fields where credentials must be physically inspected (e.g. medical, legal, engineering).

field.name: reputation_threshold_for_charging
field.help: Number of reputation points a user must accumulate in this field before they can charge for their answers (Ask Someone).

field.name: base_points_per_vote
field.help: Points awarded when an unqualified user clicks 'Good Answer'.

field.name: qualified_points_per_vote
field.help: Points awarded when a qualified professional clicks 'Good Answer'.

field.name: qualified_professional_count
field.help: Number of active qualified professionals in this field.

field.name: total_voter_count
field.help: Total distinct users who have cast a Good Answer vote in this field.

field.name: suggested_qualified_weight
field.help: Recommended qualified_points_per_vote based on the ratio of qualified to total voters.

field.name: auto_adjust_weights
field.help: When enabled, the system automatically adjusts qualified_points_per_vote to match the suggested weight.

field.name: expert_answers_trainable
field.help: When enabled, the system learns from expert answers without storing patient data — only the general medical knowledge is captured.

div.p: Use Expert Answers for Training – when checked, answers provided by verified professionals in Ask Someone sessions may be used to fine-tune the AI. The patient's original question is never stored – only the expert's response is captured. This setting is only available for fields with manual verification.

Important: Enable this only for fields where patient questions do not routinely contain Protected Health Information, or where a de-identification process is in place. For fields like dermatology or general practice, this may be appropriate; for psychiatry or HIV medicine, exercise extreme caution.

field.name: indirect_reputation_points
field.help: When a future AI answer that was improved by fine-tuning on expert answers from this field receives a 'Good Answer' vote, each contributing professional receives this many reputation points.

div.p: How indirect reputation works: Professionals whose expert answers are used for fine-tuning become contributors to the AI model. Later, when the AI generates a good answer and someone clicks "Good Answer", those original professionals automatically receive a small reputation bonus. This rewards them for helping to train the AI, even if they did not answer the current question directly.

field.name: enable_data_juicer
field.help: Enable automated data quality filtering using Alibaba's Data-Juicer (Apache-2.0). Every fine-tuning dataset for this field will be filtered through LLM-based quality scoring, deduplication, and optional PII redaction.

div.p: How Data-Juicer works: When a fine-tuning dataset is exported for this field, Data-Juicer runs the llm_quality_score_filter operator using the selected inference endpoint. Each (question, answer) pair is scored for quality. Pairs scoring below the minimum threshold are rejected. If more than the Maximum Rejection Rate of samples are rejected, Data-Juicer is automatically disabled to prevent starving the training pipeline.

Auto-disable safety net: If you enable Auto-Disable on Poor Results and the rejection rate exceeds the threshold, Data-Juicer is automatically disabled and an Odoo activity is created for the administrator. This prevents a misconfigured threshold from blocking all fine-tuning.

Dependencies: Data-Juicer must be installed in the Python environment (pip install 'py-data-juicer[generic,nlp]'). If it is not available, the quality pipeline will be skipped and the unfiltered dataset will be used.

field.name: enable_deita_scoring
field.help: Enable DEITA-based LLM-as-Judge scoring (Apache-2.0, Argilla). An LLM judge evaluates every training example on complexity, quality, and diversity.

div.p: How LLM-as-Judge works: After Data-Juicer filtering (if enabled), each surviving (question, answer) pair is scored by an LLM judge on complexity and quality. Pairs that fail to meet the minimum thresholds are rejected before training.

DEITA research backing: "DEITA introduces a way to measure data quality across three critical dimensions: complexity, quality and diversity." Models fine-tuned on a small amount of carefully selected high-quality data outperform models trained on 10× the data selected randomly.
Dependencies: distilabel[vllm] must be installed. If missing, the DEITA step will be skipped silently.

field.name: enable_ab_testing
field.help: After fine-tuning, deploy the new model as a shadow endpoint and compare its Good Answer rate against the production model.

field.name: enable_grpo_training
field.help: Use Good Answer votes as positive rewards and Ask Someone expert answers as negative preferences to optimise the model via GRPO.

field.name: min_votes_for_training
field.help: A (question, answer) pair must receive at least this many Good Answer votes before inclusion in the dataset.

field.name: min_unique_voters
field.help: A pair must be voted on by at least this many different users before inclusion. Prevents Sybil attacks.

field.name: enable_benchmark_evaluation
field.help: Run the fine-tuned model against a held-out benchmark dataset. If benchmark scores drop, the model is rejected.
